title: zephyr_remote_openocd external hardware inventory
description: Local test-lab configuration for Zephyr builds, remote OpenOCD hosts, physical targets, and operation-specific expectations.

build_environments.description: Named local Zephyr source trees and west executables shared by targets.

toolchains.description: Named local GDB toolchains used by RTT and debugserver tests.

hosts.description: Named remote Linux hosts that run OpenOCD and expose target serial devices.

targets.description: Physical boards, their builds, serial endpoints, and test-operation profiles.

identifier.description: A reusable name beginning with a letter and containing only letters, digits, underscores, or hyphens.

nonemptyString.description: A nonempty text value without NUL characters.

stringArray.description: Arguments passed as separate strings, without shell splitting.

items.description: One complete argument; do not combine multiple arguments into one string.

localPath.description: An absolute path or home-relative path interpreted on the contributor's machine.

remotePath.description: An absolute normalized POSIX path interpreted on the remote host.

commandArgument.description: One command argument passed without shell splitting; empty strings are allowed after the executable.

commandExecutable.title: Command executable
commandExecutable.description: The first command item: a nonempty executable name or absolute/home-relative path.

positiveNumber.description: A duration or interval greater than zero; fractional seconds are allowed.

namedMap.description: A mapping whose keys are reusable identifiers referenced elsewhere in the inventory.

buildEnvironments.description: One or more named local Zephyr development environments.

buildEnvironment.title: Build environment
buildEnvironment.description: A local Zephyr checkout and the west executable configured for that workspace.

zephyr_base.description: Local root of a Zephyr 4.4 source tree.

west.description: Local executable west command for this Zephyr workspace.

toolchains.description: Named local debugger toolchains; omit this section when no operation requires direct GDB.

toolchain.title: Toolchain
toolchain.description: A local architecture-specific debugger used by RTT and debugserver acceptance tests.

gdb.description: Local executable GDB matching the target architecture.

hosts.description: One or more named remote OpenOCD hosts.

host.title: Remote host
host.description: Connection and OpenOCD settings for a remote Linux machine. Serial device paths also refer to this machine.

ssh_host.description: Host name or SSH configuration alias passed to the configured SSH command.

openocd_command.description: Remote OpenOCD executable followed by optional fixed arguments. The first item must be an absolute remote path.

prefixItems.description: Absolute path to the OpenOCD executable on the remote host.

ssh_command.description: Local SSH executable and fixed arguments used for every remote action.

prefixItems.description: SSH executable name or path; it must not be empty.

items.description: One fixed SSH argument; empty strings are allowed after the executable.

forward_env.description: Environment-variable allow-list. A profile may set only names declared here.

items.description: One environment variable name allowed to reach remote OpenOCD.

path_mappings.description: Map local absolute path roots to their equivalent absolute roots on the remote host. Mappings are recursive.

additionalProperties.description: Equivalent absolute path root on the remote host.

targets.description: One or more named physical targets.

target.title: Physical target
target.description: A board attached to a remote host, plus its local build recipes and operation profiles.

host.description: Name of the remote host to which this target is attached.

build_environment.description: Name of the local Zephyr build environment used for this target.

toolchain.description: Name of the local GDB toolchain. Required when any profile enables RTT or debugserver.

board.description: Default Zephyr board identifier for every build on this target. Individual builds may override it.

builds.description: Named Zephyr application recipes referenced by profiles and preconditions.

serial.description: Named serial endpoints on the remote host. Required only by operations that observe serial output.

additionalProperties.description: One named serial endpoint on the remote host.

profiles.description: Named groups of operations that share a selected build, runner arguments, probe, and environment.

build.title: Build recipe
build.description: A Zephyr application and arguments used to produce one reusable build directory.

application.description: Application directory. Relative paths resolve beneath zephyr_base and may not escape it; absolute paths name external applications.

board.description: Zephyr board override for this build. Required when the target has no default board.

west_args.description: Arguments inserted into west build before the application and CMake separator.

cmake_args.description: CMake cache arguments passed after west build's -- separator.

serialEndpoint.title: Remote serial endpoint
serialEndpoint.description: Physical serial framing and device path as seen by the remote host.

device.description: Stable serial device path on the remote host; prefer /dev/serial/by-id over a transient tty name.

profile.title: Operation profile
profile.description: Operations sharing one firmware build and the same probe, runner arguments, and forwarded environment.

build.description: Name of the build recipe used by every operation in this profile.

probe_serial.description: Probe identifier passed to west as --dev-id. Set it when the remote host can see multiple probes.

runner_args.description: Additional remote_openocd runner arguments shared by every operation in this profile.

environment.description: Environment values forwarded to remote OpenOCD. Every key must be listed by the selected host's forward_env.

additionalProperties.description: Literal environment value forwarded without shell expansion.

operations.description: Operations enabled by this profile; each key creates an independently selectable pytest node.

flash.description: Flash a quiet precondition image, then the selected build, and prove fresh serial output.

debug.description: Load the selected build with west debug and stop at a source-level breakpoint.

attach.description: Flash a precondition image, attach without loading, and prove its memory remains unchanged.

debugserver.description: Start west debugserver and verify its GDB service using the target toolchain.

thread_info.description: Verify that the remote debug service reports Zephyr thread information.

rtt.description: Verify standalone and debug-integrated bidirectional RTT service behavior.

semihosting.description: Run direct semihosting with configured OpenOCD and GDB commands and verify relayed output.

flash.title: Flash operation
flash.description: Proves that flashing replaces a distinct quiet image and emits fresh application-specific serial output.

precondition_build.description: A declared build different from the profile build, flashed before the test image.

quiescence_timeout.description: Seconds for which the precondition image must not emit the expected test-image marker.

serial.description: Remote serial endpoint and fresh-output expectation for the selected build.

output_patterns.description: Regular expressions that must occur in combined west/OpenOCD process output.

assert_bindto.description: Require session output to prove remote OpenOCD bound to its allocated loopback address.

serialExpectation.title: Serial expectation
serialExpectation.description: Application-specific serial evidence collected from a named remote endpoint.

endpoint.description: Name of a serial endpoint declared by this target.

pattern.description: Regular expression uniquely identifying output from the selected application.

timeout.description: Seconds to wait for the serial pattern after flashing.

debug.title: Debug operation
debug.description: Loads the profile build, continues without a post-load reset, and verifies a source-level stop.

breakpoint.description: C symbol present in the ELF debug information at which GDB must stop.

output_patterns.description: Regular expressions that must occur in combined west/OpenOCD process output.

attach.title: Attach operation
attach.description: Verifies that west attach connects without replacing the firmware already on the target.

precondition_build.description: A declared build different from the profile build, flashed before attaching.

debugserver.title: Debugserver operation
debugserver.description: An empty object enables GDB-service acceptance. The target must reference a toolchain.

threadInfo.title: Thread-info operation
threadInfo.description: Checks GDB thread listings produced by an OpenOCD build with Zephyr thread awareness.

pattern.description: Regular expression expected in GDB's thread information output.

rtt.title: RTT operation
rtt.description: Exercises standalone RTT and RTT alongside debug services. The target must reference a toolchain.

port.description: Configured remote OpenOCD RTT TCP port before local forwarding.

input.description: Text sent to the target through RTT after connecting.

response.description: Application-specific text expected in the RTT response.

timeout.description: Seconds to wait for the RTT endpoint and expected response.

program_survives_reset.description: Required acknowledgement that the selected program remains usable after standalone west rtt resets the target.

breakpoint.description: C symbol used to prove GDB and RTT work concurrently.

semihosting.title: Semihosting operation
semihosting.description: Enables direct OpenOCD semihosting, drives the application with GDB, and checks relayed console output.

commands.description: OpenOCD --cmd-pre-init Tcl commands used to enable and configure semihosting.

gdb_commands.description: GDB commands executed in order; they must allow GDB and west to exit naturally.

output.description: Application-specific text required in relayed semihosting stdout/stderr.

timeout.description: Seconds allowed for the semihosting session to finish naturally.
